reviewed_by: Codex project no-prompt provider and harness policy review
reason: Project approval policy Never now suppresses would-prompt tool approvals for provider brokers and harness runtimes while retaining scope, disabled-capability, and explicit-deny enforcement. Thirty-eight focused Python cases cover provider SSH execution, frozen harness policy, harness MCP allow and explicit deny behavior, and Codex app-server approval policy. Seven component cases cover policy hydration and accessible guidance. Eight catalogued real-Core cases verify save, reload, frozen-session behavior, wording, and responsive operation across desktop, compact, and 320-430 px Chromium/WebKit profiles.
exclusions: No full suites, unrelated provider, harness, MCP, packaging, or native tests. The selected real-Core journey uses the production bundle and non-loopback LAN origin. Physical-device coverage is unavailable and is not inferred from emulation.
